description:
[read-only] Reusable text shapes per brand: sections, length targets, hook patterns, CTA slots and guardrails. Use one to shape a draft's text before create_content.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/text-templates.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands), "personal", or "all" (default: everything the key owner can see). A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.
